Place: The quiet booth of a local autumn lantern parade, with paper lanterns casting warm light against reddish wood.
Activity: As a volunteer lamp keeper she holds a paper moon over one eye during a quiet moment before the parade opens; the other eye still meets the viewer.
Pose: Standing nearly front-on, her right arm lifts a small handled paper moon clear of her cheek, her left hand holds a folded paper fan beside her hip.
Framing: A three-quarter portrait at chest height with clear warm light across her face and the booth softly receding.
Outfit: An original adult lantern-keeper roleplay costume: wine tailored shorts, a fitted high-neck halter bodice and pleated copper shoulder petals. In lifting the moon, one hinged petal folds back to expose her shoulder while the bodice remains secure.
